about.title: Where Your Clothes Get
desc: Fabrico Laundry was founded with a simple purpose: to make professional, fabric-safe garment care accessible, hygienic, and affordable for everyone.
From delicate dry cleaning to everyday wash & fold and precision steam ironing, our experienced team ensures your wardrobe always looks and feels fresh.
features: Specialised care for delicate silks, woolens & formals
Fast and reliable doorstep pickup & delivery

whyUs.title: Eco-Friendly & Safe Detergents
whyUs.desc: We use dermatologically-safe, fabric-friendly detergents and gentle solvents that protect colors.

whyUs.title: Expert Fabric Specialists
whyUs.desc: Our team knows how to treat delicate silks, woolens, formals, and designer garments.

whyUs.title: Targeted Stain Removal
whyUs.desc: Every garment is inspected and pre-treated for stubborn stains before washing.

whyUs.title: 100% Hygienic Processing
whyUs.desc: Individual wash cycles, fresh water, and sanitised processing machines for every order.

whyUs.title: Transparent Pricing

whyUs.title: Convenient Pickup & Delivery

doctor.name: The Fabrico Care Team
bio: With over 15 years of industry experience in textile care and dry cleaning, our master cleaners ensure every piece of clothing is treated with utmost care and precision.
We believe clean, well-pressed clothes give people confidence in their daily life.

expertise.title: Fabric Care You Can Trust
points: Expert stain diagnosis and fabric-safe removal
Delicate handling of silks, woolens & designer wear
Precision steam ironing and protective packaging
expertise.note: No color fading. No shrinkage. Just clean, fresh clothes every time.

testimonials.text: My wedding sherwani and blazer were returned in immaculate condition with all stains removed. Fabrico's dry cleaning service is hands down the best in Pune!
testimonials.name: Rajesh Shinde

testimonials.text: The wash & fold service is a lifesaver for working professionals. Clothes are neatly folded, smelling fresh, and delivered right on time.
testimonials.name: Priya Deshmukh

testimonials.text: Got my silk sarees and heavy winter blankets dry cleaned. Zero shrinkage and the fabric softness was perfectly preserved. Outstanding service!
testimonials.name: Sunita Patil

testimonials.text: Their shoe cleaning and sneaker restoration service made my muddy white sneakers look brand new again! Super impressed.
testimonials.name: Rohan Mehta

testimonials.text: Fast pickup and delivery with convenient WhatsApp booking. Steam ironing is crisp, wrinkle-free, and stays fresh for days.
testimonials.name: Amit Joshi

testimonials.text: Professional team, fair pricing, and excellent garment care. They even removed an old stubborn coffee stain from my favorite white shirt!
testimonials.name: Neha Kulkarni
